narrative.narrative: Bitcoin options skew widened to 32.44 volatility points from 23.15 on the October 19 expiry. The figure is the implied volatility on a put about ten percent below bitcoin minus the implied volatility on a call about ten percent above it, so a wider print means money is paying more for downside protection than for upside. The 73,000 put rose to 77.48 implied volatility from 68.2, against 45.04 on the 89,000 call, with bitcoin at 81k.
